register.labelZh: BE UP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: BE UP Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: be up 可以表示某人已經醒來並離開睡床。；be up against 可以描述艱難的競爭;be up for 則可以表示有機會獲得晉升或獎項。；be up to something 可以詢問某人在做甚麼;be up to somebody 則可以說明由誰決定或負責。；be before somebody 可以描述正式出席聆訊;be upon somebody 則表示某件事快將來臨或已經來臨。
register.summaryEn: Be up lets you say that someone is awake and has left their bed. Be up against can describe difficult competition, while be up for can describe a possible promotion or prize. Be up to something asks what someone is doing. Be up to somebody shows who must decide or take responsibility. Be before somebody can describe a formal appearance, while be upon somebody shows that an event is very close or has arrived.

contextsEn: Talk naturally about waking and daily routines

Understand formal situations and approaching events
